values.note: Online reservations close 7 days before the stay; after that sites are first-come, paid at the self-pay kiosk. The campground is unstaffed.

booking.source: https://www.aitkincountymn.gov/departments/land/land-campgrounds.php ('Reservations are made online and must be made no later than 7 days in advance of your stay. After that, it is first-come, first-served camping.') + https://mn-co-aitkin-parks.onegov.rtvision.com/ ('there is a self-pay kiosk at the park'; 'This campground is unstaffed'), read 2026-11-11

note: Aitkin County campground on a bend of the Mississippi River, within walking distance of downtown Aitkin, with a riverside walking path and a boat launch. Water at the campground is on from about the first week of May to the last week of October. --Claude
summary: County pages + OneGov read: $30 (dump $5), 9 sites (2 drive-through), 50/30/20A, flush toilets, showers, water, dump; online booking closes 7 days out, then first-come (fcfs after_cutoff, platform operator via rtvision OneGov). Riverview kept. Website domain moved to aitkincountymn.gov. No season stated.
flags: Website: https://www.co.aitkin.mn.us/departments/land/land-campground-aitkin.php -> https://www.aitkincountymn.gov/departments/land/land-campground-aitkin.php (the old domain 301-redirects there). Phone 218-927-7364 (Land Department) confirmed.

Waterfront: riverview kept. The county map shows sites 1e-7e as spurs off the east road pointing at the river; on imagery their ends are ~30-45 m from the Mississippi across a continuous band of deciduous trees and brush (e.g. the band east of sites 1e-4e around 46.5414,-93.7108). No open ground to the water, so not riverfront; a view through the trees is plausible but not proven.

Pin 46.542203,-93.71272 is on the campground loop by the boat-launch parking; the county's GPS (46 32'29"N 93 42'43"W = 46.54139,-93.71194) sits on the site row ~108 m SE. Under 250 m; no move needed.

Season: not stated for the campground. The county says water at Aitkin and Berglund 'is turned on in the first week of May and turned off the last week of October (weather/temperature dependent)' and 'Snow is not plowed at any campgrounds'; season left absent.
